Tagline — two-line layouts

A = where the em-dash sits. B = fresh copy for a two-line hero. Real tagline style; toggle light/dark.

A · em-dash placement (current copy)

A1 · dash ends line 1 (current)

"matplotlib, but beautiful —" / "built for AI agents."

B · fresh two-line copy (no dash)

B1 · two clean statements (rec)

A hard stop after "beautiful." makes each line land on its own.

Built for AI agents.
